description: Ministry of Public Security - Declare that the Port as on approved Port of entry and exit for the Purposes of this Act, 11 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Immigration and Emigration Act (Chapter 351) using powers vested by Section 3 of that Act. It declares Colombo Port City Special Port Economic Zone as an approved port of entry and exit. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the establishment of legal frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Tiran Alles, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes, so it does not qualify as a government-related type (1-3).
